306:219.en: 「$$ダンクーガ$$,\nnow this fires me up!」

306:272.en: 「Now it's $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s turn!」

306:413.en: 「Then I'll take you up on that!」

306:827.en: 「We'll hit them with all we've got!」

306:1055.en: 「Back off if you don't want a wound!」

306:2399.en: 「Then allow me to return the favor!」

306:2767.en: 「$$ダンクーガ$$ always helps the weak!」

306:2808.en: 「$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$\nis home to us!」

306:3090.en: 「Got it! Leave this side to me!」

306:3293.en: 「Looks like we need a pit stop!」

306:3361.en: 「I'm not very good at this range.」

306:3581.en: 「A model can't\nlet her skin get hurt!」

306:3739.en: 「Too bad. You missed by a mile!」

306:4021.en: 「No good. You don't fire me up.」

306:4222.en: 「Is that the best you can do?」

306:4361.en: 「I know. I'll do it right next time.」

306:4738.en: 「This tension... I kind of like it!」

306:4767.en: 「They hit, I hit back!\nThat's my way!」

306:4941.en: 「$$朔哉$$, how are things over there?!」

306:5046.en: 「$$エイーダ$$, prepare for the next attack!」

306:5640.en: 「$$エイーダ$$! At least you should escape!」

306:6623.en: 「I'll show them what I can do!」

306:7383.en: 「$$エイーダ$$! Are you all right?!」

306:7606.en: 「Then let me share a useful tip!」

306:8127.en: 「$$葵$$! You know what to do, right?」

306:8884.en: 「Make sure you get plenty of rest!」

306:9072.en: 「Hey, that's supposed to be my line!」

306:9115.en: 「Ah! I knew someone would say it!」

306:9194.en: 「It's finally my turn! One more shot!」

306:9857.en: 「There must still be a chance to win!」

306:10051.en: 「So you were in here playing games!」

306:10102.en: 「How the hell do you know that?」

306:10643.en: 「Yes! It was only a little shake!」

alternatives: I'll endure this wound by willpower!

306:11004.en: 「I leave the future to you, $$ダンクーガ$$.」

306:11070.en: 「All of $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ rests with you!」

306:11179.en: 「Time you learned how vast space is!」

306:11427.en: 「We'll leave peacemaking to the pros,\nand as for us...!」

306:11513.en: 「Things should change soon enough,\nso this is where we hold on...!」

306:11590.en: 「If there's a fight,\nwe show up too!」

306:12296.en: 「Leave the rest to your big sisters!」

306:13611.en: 「Turn tail and run while you can!」

306:14426.en: 「I told you, don't say it first!」

306:14538.en: 「After I went to all that effort...!」

306:14789.en: 「$$ダンクーガ$$'s a Super Robot.\nNo mercy!」
